helpRules.levelProgression: You unlock the next CEFR level only by passing the proficiency exam of the previous level; you cannot access content in a locked level.
helpRules.grammarSequence: In Grammar, each topic has a topic explanation first, then exercises and a topic quiz; the next topic opens only after you complete the previous ones.
helpRules.vocabularyWindow: In Vocabulary, at most {window} sections are open at the same time within a level; finishing one of the open sections opens the next.
helpRules.studyTimer: You select the words you want to learn and start the timer; when the timer ends (about 30 seconds), those words become ready for the quiz.
helpRules.wordQuota: You can select at most {limit} words in each learning cycle; you cannot start a new timer until the previous cycle's timer ends and you take the quiz.
helpRules.skillsCompletion: In the Reading, Listening, Writing, and Speaking sections, a section isn't considered complete until you listen to or read the content and finish the exercises.

Dashboard.helpStepsSubtitle: The recommended order to follow in a daily session; you can quickly return to where you left off from the cards above.

overview.title: Check your workshop
overview.body: Review your level progress, quick continue links, and the word quiz timer in the cards at the top; you can pick up where you left off from there.

grammar.title: Continue with Grammar
grammar.body: Enter a topic suited to your level; read the topic explanation, finish the exercises, and pass the topic quiz. Reinforce with combined exercises if needed.

vocabulary.title: Study vocabulary
vocabulary.body: Mark the words you want to learn in the Vocabulary section and start the timer. When the time is up, take the word quiz; in a full cycle you can select at most {limit} words (target: {quizTarget} words).

skills.title: Complete the skill sections
skills.body: Progress in order through Reading, Listening, Writing, and Speaking; in each section, read or listen to the text and finish the exercises.

levelExam.title: Take the proficiency exam
levelExam.body: After finishing the grammar topics and exercises at your level, take that level's proficiency exam; passing it unlocks the next level.

progress.title: Track your progress
progress.body: Follow your points, level status, and known words in the Progress section; keep going with regular short sessions.

Vocabulary.verbsDocumentTitle: Dil Atölyesi - Regular and irregular verbs
Vocabulary.verbsSubtitle: Review the infinitive (V1), past simple (V2), and past participle (V3) forms; reinforce them with exercises.
Vocabulary.verbsLetterFilterAria: Filter by starting letter of the infinitive
Vocabulary.verbsRegularHint: In regular verbs, V2 and V3 are usually the same: verb + -ed/-d (e.g., work → worked). If the verb ends in consonant + y, -y becomes -ied (study → studied).
Vocabulary.verbsIrregularHint: In irregular verbs, V2 and V3 don't follow a fixed rule; they are usually memorized (e.g., go → went → gone). Some verbs have the same V2 and V3 (e.g., put → put → put), while in others only V2 changes (e.g., come → came → come).

Vocabulary.falseFriendsSubtitle: Learn the meanings of English words without confusing them with their Turkish look-alikes.
Vocabulary.falseFriendsHint: A word may look or sound similar to a Turkish word but have a different meaning; be especially careful when translating.
Vocabulary.phrasalVerbsSubtitle: Everyday expressions made of a verb + preposition/adverb; their meaning is usually learned as a whole.
Vocabulary.phrasalVerbsHint: The meaning of a phrasal verb is often different from the verb alone. In separable phrasal verbs, the object can go between the verb and the particle.

Landing.headline: Dil Atölyesi: everything under one roof
Landing.subheadline: Lessons, vocabulary and grammar, listening–reading, speaking patterns, and AI-powered exercises come together in a single workshop. Your progress is saved; you decide when to study and how far to go.
Landing.levelsCaption: After signing up, you are placed from A1 to C2 with a short level test. You choose your starting step; you can also start from a level lower than the test suggests, with A1 as the floor. Steps open in order; as you complete them, the rest of the path lies ahead of you.

EducationSystem.title: Education System
EducationSystem.subtitle: A learning path that starts with a level test after sign-up and is shaped around your pace with lessons, AI-powered exercises, and progress tracking.

level.title: Determine your level
level.body: After signing up, you take a short level test. Based on your results, we place you at level 0, A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, or C2. If you like, you can start from a level lower than your test result, even from 0; for example, even if you score A2, you can progress from scratch to rebuild the foundation. The same flexibility applies to every level.

lessons.title: Progress with daily lessons
lessons.body: Lessons suited to the starting level you choose open in order. Each lesson focuses on a single topic: listening, reading, grammar, or speaking patterns. You practice regularly in short sessions and grow your knowledge day by day; you can progress further on days you wish, and slow down on busy days.

practice.title: Reinforce with AI
practice.body: After lessons, you apply vocabulary, grammar, and patterns in context with AI-powered exercises. The exercises are shaped by your level and the points where you are weaker; so you get practice that goes beyond memorization and is close to real use. With spaced repetition, what you learn becomes lasting.

progress.title: See your progress
progress.body: Completed lessons, AI exercises, strengthening vocabulary, and your level goals are visible at a glance. Where you are, your next step, and which topic needs more practice stay clear. As you progress, your move to the next CEFR level also becomes measurable.

what.question: What is Dil Atölyesi?
what.answer: Dil Atölyesi is a language learning platform that offers step-by-step lessons, vocabulary study, AI-powered exercises, and progress tracking so you can learn English at your own pace.

level.question: Which level is it suitable for?
level.answer: With the level test you take after signing up, you are placed at A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, or C2. If you like, you can also start from a lower level; even if you score A2 or above, progressing from A1 to strengthen your foundation is your choice. The same flexibility applies to all levels.

ai.question: How do the AI-powered exercises work?
ai.answer: After lessons, you get exercises personalized to your level and needs. They help you put vocabulary, grammar, and usage practice into context, and let you focus more on the topics where you are weaker.

free.question: Can I use it for free?
free.answer: Yes. You can start for free by creating an account. Advanced package options will be added soon.

pace.question: How much time do I need to set aside?
pace.answer: You progress at your own pace. Short, regular daily practice is enough for lasting learning.

contact.question: Who can I write to for help?
contact.answer: You can reach us from the Contact page or at admin@dilatolyesi.com. We usually reply within one business day.

benefits.title: Benefits
benefits.description: Strengthen your vocabulary, clarify your grammar, and communicate with confidence through regular practice, AI-powered exercises, level-appropriate content, and clear goals.
